metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec). The experimental paradigm employed a P300 visual oddball task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid and gaze conditions. Single sessions were conducted per subject with target and non-target stimulus presentations. Trial intervals spanned 0 to 1.0 seconds with a 60 Hz line frequency.
